The '''Vorheim Gallery''' was a gallery on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aurea]]. [[Bryn Shale]], a famous [[Thief/Legends|thief]], claimed she would steal the sculpture ''[[Dawn of Light]]'' during its exposition at the gallery.<ref name="SOF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>
